releaseNotes:
# 24.12.6
The long awaited audio loading overhaul and some minor fixes and improvements.

## Changes / Improvements
- Improved preloaded asset RAM usage.
- Improved GC in some key high use areas.
- Added NAudio for editor file loading to ensure greater compatibility with more audio formats.
- Prefab timeline objects now take collapsed contained objects into account when calculating their size.
